subject: Psychology
central_question: How do the self and personality develop, differ across people and cultures, and how can personality be understood and assessed?
in_scope_units: Cognitive and behavioural aspects of self
banned_topics: Diagnosis and treatment of psychological disorders

known_pitfalls.correction: Psychological personality is a relatively unique and stable pattern of behaviour, thought and emotion.

known_pitfalls.claim: One test gives a complete, infallible personality profile.
known_pitfalls.correction: Different methods reveal different aspects and require trained, cautious interpretation.

recommended_example_progression: NCERT Activity 2.1: identify personal and social identity.
NCERT Activity 2.2: reflect on a personality aspect to change.
NCERT Review Questions 4–5: compare trait/type approaches and Freud.
NCERT Review Questions 8–10: compare assessment methods.
NCERT Review Question 11: apply Rogers' terminology.
ncert_end_of_chapter_exercises_reference: The end-of-chapter Review Questions contain Questions 1–11, followed by two Project Ideas.
